title: Case-split at the prime 3 (the 3-5 switch) for Wiles semistable modularity
intent: Reduce Wiles's semistable modularity theorem — every integral Weierstrass model W with Δ ≠ 0 and IsSemistableModel is modular — to a case split on whether the mod-3 Galois representation ρ̄_{W,3} is irreducible, and close each branch from already-proved project lemmas (Langlands–Tunnell, modularity lifting, the 3-5 switch), leaving ~35 lines of glue that only extract record fields and prove two small Nat divisibility facts.

applicability.goal_shape: ∀ W : WeierstrassCurve ℤ, W.IsSemistableModel → (W.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)).IsModular, split by by_cases on a decidable property of one fixed prime (W.ModRepIsIrreducible 3); each branch ends by applying isModular_map_of_mlc1 to a liftingAtConductor lemma that consumes a residual-modularity level M with its side conditions.
applicability.use_when: the goal forks on a decidable predicate whose two alternatives are each already proved as named project lemmas, and one branch can be reduced to the other by a switch construction (threeFiveSwitchCurve) that hands over a second model and a trace congruence mod 5; the glue is then only obtain field extraction, NeZero instances, and small Nat divisibility facts.
applicability.avoid_when: the branch lemmas do not exist yet (each is deep — Langlands-Tunnell, Taylor-Wiles R = T lifting, the Rubin-Silverberg switch — so the split is a roadmap, not a proof); the disjunction is not decidable/exhaustive; or the two branches need genuinely different arguments that no switch lemma can bridge.

claims.claim: The parent modularity_of_semistableModel' closes as a by_cases split on h3 : W.ModRepIsIrreducible 3, and each branch ends in exact isModular_map_of_mlc1 (liftingAtConductor_...), with no other closing tactic.

The main proof (lines 167-201) is 35 lines, invokes 7 distinct named lemmas (10 invocations: isResiduallyModular_three_…, isModular_map_of_mlc1 and liftingAtConductor_three_of_level_hns twice each, the other four once), and its only local proofs are two have-blocks of Nat divisibility/unit bookkeeping (h25 at lines 191-194, hN3 at lines 196-197).

claims.claim: PROOF-PATH.md step 4 states the plan and its final sentence matches the two branches exactly: 'If ρ̄_{W,3} is irreducible, Langlands-Tunnell and lifting at 3; otherwise the switch gives W′, the first case makes W′ modular, W is residually modular mod 5, and lifting at 5 finishes.'

Below the main theorem lies a chain of three project lemmas: modularity_of_semistableModel' calls liftingAtConductor_three_of_level_hns (line 175), whose body calls modularityLiftingAtConductor_threeFive_of_level_of_inertia_moves_torsion_of_eq_three_of_not_cube_dvd (line 151), whose body is a wrapper over P2M.Sol.S_WeierstrassCurve_modularityLiftingAtConductor_threeFive_of_level_of_inertia_moves_torsion_of_eq_three_of_not_cube_dvd.solution (context file line 129).
The same-file theorem solution (lines 208-210) reuses WeierstrassCurve.modularity_of_semistableModel' unchanged, so this decomposition is exactly the step the top-level FLT proof plugs into.

metrics.how_counted: parent_lines = lines 165-201 inclusive (statement plus proof); children = the 7 distinct named lemmas the glue uses; direct_lemma_invocations = every occurrence in lines 167-201 (three lemmas used twice, four once); local_nat_have_blocks = the two have terms h25 (¬5^2∣N) and hN3 (∀q, q≠5→¬q^3∣N)

consequences: The split creates exactly two obligations (h3 and ¬h3) and no exhaustiveness child: by_cases discharges exhaustiveness via excluded middle on the decidable Prop W.ModRepIsIrreducible 3 (unlike a mod_cases residue split, which needs an exhaustiveness proof). Each branch must produce a Mlc1IsModularModelOfExactConductorLevel for isModular_map_of_mlc1, which forces the glue to carry a residual level M and its conditions — the two local have-blocks (h25, hN3) and two NeZero instances are exactly those obligations. The branches are symmetric only because threeFiveSwitchCurve carries the mod-5 trace congruence at every common good prime ℓ ≠ 5; without that congruence the isResiduallyModularOfLevel_of_switch call would not typecheck.
